candidates.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow on November 12 for planned talks with Vladimir Putin following U.S.-mediated Russian-Ukrainian negotiations in Abu Dhabi. Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev met them at Vnukovo Airport. Their arrival was confirmed; the sources did not establish that the meeting with Putin had concluded.
candidates.title: U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow following Abu Dhabi negotiations

candidates.summary: At a November 12 news conference in Kuala Lumpur, Mongolian special envoy Zandanshatar Gombojav disclosed that Mongolia had sent Malaysia a diplomatic protest note on November 10 over the Altantuya Shaariibuu murder case. He called for review of a civil judgment, efforts to return a convicted officer from Australia, examination of potentially new evidence and a written response. The protest itself was sent earlier; the target-day development was its public disclosure.
candidates.title: Mongolian envoy discloses diplomatic protest over Altantuya murder case

candidates.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin on November 12 for approximately two hours, then departed for Ireland for planned talks with Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Kushner said securing European participation in negotiations was one objective. Putin reiterated his opposition to European troops in Ukraine after a ceasefire. The meeting followed Russian-Ukrainian talks in Abu Dhabi that ended November 11 with a prisoner-exchange agreement but no major breakthrough.
candidates.title: U.S. envoys meet Putin in Moscow and depart for Ireland

candidates.summary: Nvidia announced November 12 that Jensen Huang had resigned as chief executive and that chief financial officer Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO. The board said it would consider internal and external candidates for a permanent replacement and named Harvey C. Jones chairman. Huang's departure followed disclosures of extramarital relationships, including one with a businesswoman alleged to have acted as a Chinese intelligence agent; that allegation remains attributed rather than established here.
candidates.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress appointed interim chief

candidates.summary: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to the People's Consultative Assembly on November 12, following earlier communications with President Prabowo Subianto. His departure followed controversy over his educational qualifications and eligibility for office. ANTARA reported that the House of Representatives canceled a planned plenary meeting concerning a possible impeachment motion after the resignation letter was submitted.
candidates.title: Indonesia's vice president formally submits resignation to parliamentary assembly

candidates.summary: A gunman killed a man at a gym and shot four other people near Washington's Logan Circle around 8 a.m. on November 12, police said. Interim Metropolitan Police Chief Jeffery Carroll said another victim was in critical condition. Police cordoned off the area near 15th Street Northwest, and schools were locked down.
candidates.title: Logan Circle shootings leave one victim dead and four others wounded
candidates.geography: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

candidates.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin for about two hours on November 12, then met Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin, AP reported. Kushner said an objective was securing Russian agreement to European participation in negotiations. Putin reiterated opposition to European troops in Ukraine after a ceasefire. Earlier Russian-Ukrainian talks in Abu Dhabi produced a prisoner-exchange agreement but no major breakthrough.
candidates.title: U.S. envoys meet Putin in Moscow, then Zelenskyy in Dublin

candidates.summary: Police said a gunman killed a building manager at a Logan Circle gym around 8 a.m. on November 12, then shot four other people from his condominium patio. Interim police chief Jeffery Carroll identified the suspect as Matt Lambert, 55, and said he fatally shot himself after speaking with police negotiators. One wounded victim remained in critical condition by late afternoon. Court records showed litigation between Lambert and building management over conditions in his unit.
candidates.title: Police say Logan Circle gunman killed himself after killing one and wounding four
candidates.geography: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

candidates.summary: Microsoft experienced widespread service disruptions on November 12 affecting Outlook email and other applications. Nearly 130,000 Outlook problem reports appeared on Downdetector shortly after 1 p.m. Eastern; these were user reports, not a verified count of affected accounts. Microsoft said unexpectedly unavailable servers had increased load on remaining infrastructure and that it was testing a fix. Williamson County, Texas, separately confirmed disruption to its Outlook email services.
candidates.title: Microsoft outage disrupts Outlook and other workplace services

candidates.summary: Oklahoma executed James Pavatt, 73, by lethal injection at the state penitentiary in McAlester on November 12 for the fatal shooting of his girlfriend's estranged husband, Rob Andrew. He was pronounced dead at 10:12 a.m. Central. The U.S. Supreme Court denied his application for a stay of execution and his petition for review that day.
candidates.title: Oklahoma executes James Pavatt after Supreme Court denies stay
